The actual feature/model/loss, predraw deadline, canonical writer and certificate owners are unchanged.
Recognize existing cooperative scopes as research for writer priority, including CP12 names; no numeric changes.
R68: Move existing database health read to a background worker; error rendering and lifecycle guard only. Shared DB ownership and numeric code unchanged.
Read-only duplicate poll admission. Changed/conflicting draws keep canonical writer; identical confirmed values do not retrain or alter features.
R68: Lazy-open DbStore on the existing serial background handler; encompass model status in error handling. Import and rollback retain their original owners and authorization.
R68: Use ZIP deflate level 6; existing lossless per-member SHA, byte count and CRC readback stay enforced.
R68: Reuse the owner-verified immutable snapshot hash instead of hashing the same private file twice. Resume still verifies SHA and size; no live database mutations.
